title: How the Priesthood Reveals Jehovah’s Love
source: The Watchtower (Study), September 2026, pp. 20–25, study article for November 23–29, 2026
noMatch: Great question! Let’s ask Mom or Dad after the meeting!

qa.a: This week is about priests. Jehovah gave us priests because he loves us and wants us to come close to him.
A priest helps people come close to God. Priests taught people God’s Law, and they offered sacrifices for people.
Because of sin. Sin is like a big gap between people and God, and we can’t cross it by ourselves. Jehovah gave the priesthood to help us.

qa.q: What does the bridge picture mean?
qa.a: Sin made a gap between people and God. The priesthood is like a bridge over that gap.
Priests were teachers. They taught God’s Law and helped people understand it, so they could obey it and get closer to Jehovah.
In Nehemiah’s day, 13 Levites helped the priest Ezra explain the Law to the people, so they could understand what was read.
A sacrifice was a gift offered to Jehovah. Priests offered sacrifices for the people so their sins could be forgiven.

qa.q: How did people feel when they were forgiven?
qa.a: They felt so relieved! When the Israelites were sorry for their sins, it was a relief to know Jehovah forgave them.

qa.q: What did Noah do after the ark?
qa.a: After Noah came out of the ark, he offered sacrifices to say thank you to Jehovah.

qa.q: Did Abraham and Job offer sacrifices?
qa.a: Yes! Long ago the family head offered sacrifices for his family. Abraham built altars, and Job offered sacrifices for his children.
Melchizedek was the first person the Bible calls a priest. He was a king too! Jesus is also both a King and a Priest.

qa.q: Who was Israel’s first high priest?
qa.a: Aaron, Moses’ brother. Aaron and his sons served as priests, and the Levites helped them.
Jesus! He became the High Priest when he got baptized. He helps us and speaks to Jehovah for us.
Jesus gave his perfect life for us. His sacrifice is much better than animal sacrifices. It makes real forgiveness and life forever possible.

qa.q: Does Jesus talk to Jehovah about me?
qa.a: Yes! Jesus is a helper with the Father. He sees the good things you do and how you try to do better, and Jehovah listens to him.

qa.q: Can I talk to Jehovah in prayer?
qa.a: Yes! Because of Jesus, you can talk to Jehovah freely in prayer. Jehovah is happy to hear you, even when you don’t know what to say.

qa.q: Does Jehovah want us to live forever?
qa.a: Yes! Jehovah wants us to have life. Jesus’ sacrifice opens the way for obedient people to live forever.

qa.q: Who will help Jesus as priests?
qa.a: 144,000 anointed ones will serve with Jesus in heaven as kings and priests. They will help make the earth a paradise.

qa.q: What will happen in the Thousand Year Reign?
qa.a: During Jesus’ Thousand Year Reign, the priests will help obedient people become perfect, and the earth will be made a paradise.
Yes! Jesus lived on earth, so he got tired, hungry and thirsty too. He understands how we feel.

qa.q: Did Jesus ever lose a friend?
qa.a: Yes. Jesus’ friend Lazarus died. Jesus lived on earth, so he knows how we feel and cares for us with understanding.
Yes! They once lived on earth too. They know what it is like to make mistakes and to be sick, so they can understand us.
Jehovah is full of love, mercy and compassion. He wants to be our Friend and is ready to forgive.

qa.q: What if I make a mistake?
qa.a: Jehovah knows we are made of dust. He looks past our mistakes and sees the good in us. We can ask him to forgive us.

qa.q: Does Jehovah want to be my friend?
qa.a: Yes! Jehovah wants to be close to you. That is why he gave us the priesthood and Jesus.
Hebrews 5:1: “Every high priest taken from among men is appointed in their behalf.”
We start the study with Song 107, “The Divine Pattern of Love.” We end it with Song 16, “Praise Jah for His Son, the Anointed.”
